subject: Report access request and NDA — pen test materials for Acme Financial
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmefi.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal - Acme Financial <legal@acmefi.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: penetration test report + exec summary for vendor security review

Hi Rachel,

As part of Acme Financial's vendor onboarding we need to review your most recent penetration test and an executive summary for our security intake (SIG + CAIQ context). Our procurement team flagged a few items: we typically request either the full report under NDA or a redacted full report plus a short exec summary if the former isn't possible.

Could you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can share the full pen test report under a mutual NDA (we can provide ours), or if you prefer to provide a redacted version + exec summary?
- What redaction strategy you use for IOCs/proof-of-concept code and internal IPs?
- An estimated delivery date; we are aiming to finish our review by 2027-05-02.

If a mutual NDA is needed please advise who on your legal/compliance team should be on the DocuSign. Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Tara
Tara Singh
Security Program Manager, Acme Financial
[tara.singh@acmefi.com]

[Attachment: Acme-Vendor-Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmefi.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report + exec summary for vendor security review

Hi Tara — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can support a couple of sharing paths; I've summarized below so you can pick what works best for Acme: 

Option A — Mutual NDA then full report in secure, time-limited data room
- We sign a mutual NDA (we generally use a redlineable mutual NDA; DocuSign link can be shared).
- After NDA, we provide the full pen test report in a read-only data room for a 30-day window.
- High-risk IOCs (exploit code, ephemeral creds, cloud account IDs) will be redacted from any downloadable artifacts; evidence images remain view-only.

Option B — Redacted full report + detailed exec summary (faster)
- We produce a redacted copy with POC/exploit detail and internal host identifiers removed, plus a 2–3 page executive summary and a remediation status table.
- Redactions follow our Redaction Playbook (attached).

Access matrix we need for either option (please confirm):
- Names and emails of Acme reviewers
- Role (Security/Procurement/Legal)
- Storage location (e.g., company vault vs personal email) and retention period (we enforce 90 days by default)

I've attached our Redaction_Playbook_v1.1.pdf and an editable NDA_template_Redwood_v2.docx for your legal team to review.

If Acme prefers not to sign our template, we're able to review your mutual NDA — happy to coordinate. Proposed next steps: you confirm the access matrix + select Option A or B, then we will route the NDA and target the delivery by 2027-04-29 for Option B or 2027-05-02 for Option A.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Security & Trust Lead, Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com]
[Attachment: Redaction_Playbook_v1.1.pdf (PDF, 112KB)]

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmefi.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal - Acme Financial <legal@acmefi.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report + exec summary for vendor security review

Thanks Rachel — copying our legal team. A few clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- Acme will not sign unilateral vendor templates; we prefer a mutual NDA (attached our standard). Can Redwood review and sign? (attached: Acme-Mutual-NDA.pdf)
- For redaction, we need a short sample (1–2 pages) showing how you sanitize POC code and cloud identifiers before we approve Option B.
- Access matrix: security reviewers (max 6 people) and procurement. Storage must be in our corporate GCP Vault or in a read-only data room we provide. Retention: 90 days acceptable.

If Redwood can supply a redacted sample and accept a mutual NDA we can proceed with Option B for speed. Target delivery still 2027-04-29.

Regards,
Tara

[Attachment: Acme-Mutual-NDA.pdf (PDF, 46KB)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Acme request — proposed access matrix and redaction approach

Hi Neha / Karthik — forwarding Acme's asks. TL;DR: they will only sign a mutual NDA and want a 1–2 page redacted sample before we hand over a redacted full report. Procurement wants 6 reviewers and 90-day retention.

Proposed access matrix (please confirm):
- Reviewer list: up to 6 named individuals (Security lead + 4 engineers + Procurement manager)
- Storage: Acme's corporate vault or Redwood read-only data room (we'll prefer our data room unless they insist on their vault; both are OK under NDA)
- Retention: 90 days
- Download: disabled (view-only)

Redaction plan (high level):
- Remove/replace exploit POC code blocks with [REDACTED-PoC] and provide a short description of the class of vulnerability (e.g., "input validation -> RCE")
- Remove internal IPs, cloud account IDs, ephemeral credentials and replace with tokens like [REDACTED-IP-1]
- Keep risk rating, affected component names (high level), remediation steps, and remediation status (open/in-progress/closed)

Action items: 
- Neha: can you prepare a 1–2 page redacted sample and a redacted executive summary by 2027-04-26? Please follow the attached Redaction_Playbook_v1.1.
- Karthik: if Acme sends their mutual NDA we need a commercial OK to sign — any concessions we should expect? Also please confirm who owns the DocuSign routing (legal or commercial).

Attaching my proposed Access_Matrix_proposal.xlsx for your review.

Thanks,
Rachel
[Attachment: Access_Matrix_proposal.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmefi.com>, Legal - Acme Financial <legal@acmefi.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report + exec summary for vendor security review

Hi Tara — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending your mutual NDA. We've reviewed and are willing to sign your mutual NDA via DocuSign. Next steps and deliverables below: 

Deliverables we will provide once the NDA is executed:
- Redacted executive summary (attached): Redacted_Executive_Summary_Acme.pdf
- Remediation status table (attached): Remediation_Status_Table.csv
- Sample redacted pages (embedded in the executive summary PDF) showing how POC code and cloud IDs are tokenized (no real exploit code).

If the NDA is fully executed and Acme confirms the final reviewer list we will: 
- Provision a read-only data room link (30-day access window) that contains the sanitized full report (download disabled) OR grant access to Acme's vault based on your preference.
- Provide a short walkthrough (30–45 minutes) with our security engineer to talk through findings and remediation timelines.

DocuSign link (Acme mutual NDA): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/acme-mutual-nda
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/ACME-6789

Attached: Redacted_Executive_Summary_Acme.pdf, Remediation_Status_Table.csv

Proposed timeline if we receive a signed NDA and reviewer list by 2027-04-27:
- 2027-04-28: Send redacted exec summary + sample pages (we've attached earlier)
- 2027-04-29: Provision data room with sanitized full report (Option B)

If you'd prefer Option A (full report in data room after mutual NDA without sample), we can do that as well but it will push the delivery to 2027-05-02.

Let me know which option you prefer and please route the NDA to the signatories listed in the DocuSign flow.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Security & Trust Lead | Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com]

[Attachments: Redacted_Executive_Summary_Acme.pdf (PDF, 8KB), Remediation_Status_Table.csv (CSV, 3KB)]
